name: Differentiable Radiative Rasterization
definition: A GPU-friendly rasterization process implemented in CUDA that renders novel X-ray projections from the radiative Gaussian point clouds.
summary: Differentiable Radiative Rasterization is a GPU-friendly CUDA process that renders novel X-ray projections by summing radiation intensities weighted by Gaussian probability density, tailored for X-ray attenuation physics.
